stats.text:
If you take the Dodge action, you gain the following benefits: until the start of your next turn, any attack roll made against you has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexterity saving throws with {ref:glossary/advantage}.

You lose these benefits if you have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition or if your {ref:glossary/speed} is 0.
